```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(corrplot)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(DHARMa)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(knitr)
library(ggstatsplot)

library(glmmTMB)
```


# Read in climate and field data
```{r, include=FALSE}
field_climate_08_23_inc <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, na.strings="NA")%>%
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = (-1*(1 - (SHM/Site_SHM)))*100)%>% #calculate the SHM transfer distance in terms of percent 
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = round(SHM_mult_dist, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(MAT_dist_sq = MAT_dist^2,
         MAP_dist_sq = MAP_dist^2,
         MCMT_dist_sq = MCMT_dist^2,
         TD_dist_sq = TD_dist^2,
         MSP_dist_sq = MSP_dist^2,
         MWMT_dist_sq = MWMT_dist^2,
         CMD_dist_sq = CMD_dist^2,
         CMI_dist_sq = CMI_dist^2,
         SHM_mult_dist_sq = SHM_mult_dist^2) %>%
  mutate(LD = as.factor(if_else(TS == 1, "L",
                      if_else(TS == 2, "L",
                              if_else(TS == 3, "L","D")))))
field_climate_08_23_inc$Unique_ID <- seq_len(nrow(field_climate_08_23_inc))

field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))

live_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>% filter(TS==1|TS==2|TS==3) #7881 live trees assessed

dead_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>%filter(LD=='D') %>%dplyr::select("Unique_ID","LD")
# 302 dead trees assessed for sunken bole, pitching on bole, galls
```

# Tip dieback
## Percentiles of interest
0 - 0
0.5x - 38
1x - 75
2x - 150
3x - 225

## Sim 1
```{r,echo=FALSE}
set.seed(25)
#0x - 0 trees
tipdbrand_0 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=0), ] %>% mutate(tipdb_0 = 1)

#0.5x - 83 trees
tipdbrand_05 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=38), ] %>% mutate(tipdb_05 = 1)

#1x - 165 trees
tipdbrand_1 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=75), ] %>% mutate(tipdb_1 = 1)

#2x - 331 trees
tipdbrand_2 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=150), ] %>% mutate(tipdb_2 = 1)

#3x - 496 trees
tipdbrand_3 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=225), ] %>% mutate(tipdb_3 = 1)


tipdb_sensDD_join <- left_join(dead_trees,tipdbrand_0, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,tipdbrand_05, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,tipdbrand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,tipdbrand_2, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,tipdbrand_3, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

tipdb_sensDD_repl <- tipdb_sensDD_join %>%
  mutate(tipdbrand_0 = if_else(is.na(tipdb_0),0, tipdb_0))%>%
  mutate(tipdbrand_05 = if_else(is.na(tipdb_05),0, tipdb_05))%>%
  mutate(tipdbrand_1 = if_else(is.na(tipdb_1),0, tipdb_1))%>%
  mutate(tipdbrand_2 = if_else(is.na(tipdb_2),0, tipdb_2))%>%
  mutate(tipdbrand_3 = if_else(is.na(tipdb_3),0, tipdb_3))


tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims <- left_join(field_climate_08_23_inc,tipdb_sensDD_repl, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(tipdbrand_0:tipdbrand_3), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), TipDB01, .)))
```

### Standardized variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}
tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist_std <- (tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist - mean(tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist))
tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist_std <- (tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist - mean(tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist))
tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist_std <- (tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist - mean(tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist))
```

### Models
```{r, echo=FALSE}
modtipdb.OG <- glmmTMB(TipDB01 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = field_climate_08_23_inc, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modtipdb1.DD0x <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_0 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modtipdb1.DD05x <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_05 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modtipdb.DD0xboth <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_0 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modtipdb.DD05xlow <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_05 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))


modtipdb1.DD1x <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_1 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modtipdb1.DD2x <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_2 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modtipdb1.DD3x <- glmmTMB(tipdbrand_3 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_tipdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```

### Tidy dataframes
```{r,echo=FALSE}
modtipdbOG_df<-tidy(modtipdb.OG, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
modtipdbOG_df$model <- "OG"
modtipdbOG_df$multiplier <- "Original model"

sim1tipdb0x_df<-tidy(modtipdb1.DD0x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1tipdb0x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1tipdb0x_df$multiplier <- "0"

sim1tipdb05x_df<-tidy(modtipdb1.DD05x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1tipdb05x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1tipdb05x_df$multiplier <- "0.5x"

sim1tipdb1x_df<-tidy(modtipdb1.DD1x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1tipdb1x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1tipdb1x_df$multiplier <- "1x"

sim1tipdb2x_df<-tidy(modtipdb1.DD2x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1tipdb2x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1tipdb2x_df$multiplier <- "2x"

sim1tipdb3x_df<-tidy(modtipdb1.DD3x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1tipdb3x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1tipdb3x_df$multiplier <- "3x"
```

  left_join(.,tipdb9rand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%

  mutate(tipdb9rand_1 = if_else(is.na(tipdb_1),0, tipdb_1))%>%

## Coefficient plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
tipdbcoefs_ALL <- read.csv("TipDiebackProb_sim_coefs.csv")%>% mutate(term = fct_relevel(term, "(Intercept)", "I(TD_dist_std^2)","TD_dist_std","I(SHM_dist_std^2)","SHM_dist_std","I(MWMT_dist_std^2)","MWMT_dist_std")) %>%
  mutate(multiplier = fct_relevel(multiplier, "0","0.5x","1x","2x","3x", "Original model")) 


pal5_t <- turbo(5, alpha=1, begin=0.2, end=1)
pal6 <- c("#3E9BFEFF", "#46F884FF", "#E1DD37FF", "#F05B12FF", "#7A0403FF","gray")

(coeftipdb<- tipdbcoefs_ALL %>% filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>% 
              ggplot(aes(estimate, term, color=multiplier, xmin=conf.low,xmax = conf.high)) + 
    theme_classic()+
 
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")+
      geom_point(aes(color=multiplier),
  fill="black",alpha=0.3,pch=21, position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")  +
   scale_color_manual("Multiplier",values=pal6,labels = c('0x', '0.5x', '1x','2x','3x',"Original model"))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient",y =NULL, title="Probability of tip dieback")+
   scale_y_discrete(labels = c(expression(paste("TD"^"2")),"TD",expression(paste("SHM"^"2")),"SHM",expression(paste("MWMT"^"2")),"MWMT"))+
     theme(legend.position=c(0.25,0.7),legend.background=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11)))
ggsave(coeftipdb, file="SSMT_FH_tipdb_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=6, width=6)
```
